package.name: talos_mirror
package.description: M2 synthetic exercise for the vendored PAL TALOS full-body humanoid (talos_moveit_config): a 50 Hz sine sweep across all 30 group joints (arm_l, arm_r, head, torso, leg_l, leg_r), hard-clamped at the measured URDF limits, publishing JointTrajectory to the six mock JointTrajectoryControllers talos_moveit_config brings up. Also carries the acceptance tool (tools/talos_check.py) that checks the SRDF groups, cross-checks docs/joints.json against the live URDF, FK/IK sanity, and controller spawn state -- ported from examples/humanoid_mirror's ffw_check.py / mirror_accept.py pattern (see TECHNICAL.md there for the subprocess-drains-queued-messages, never-rate-limit-from-arrival-times, and acos/asin-wraps-before-range-check traps this package avoids). M3 adds talos_track: full-body webcam tracking (body_track.py + pose_source.py, ported and extended from humanoid_mirror with the leg chain and per-limb gating) publishing human/* TF, /body/observation (std_msgs/String JSON) and /body/markers with the robot parked.
